segments.name: Teahouse network
segments.description: Runs a teahouse network across China and overseas, serving freshly-made tea drinks to consumers and franchising teahouses to franchise partners.
segments.evidence: Our extensive and well-managed teahouse network has been a critical factor in our growth and strong results.

revenueModel.text: Franchise partners pay fixed franchise and store opening fees plus percentage fees on their teahouses' sales, and buy materials and supplies from the company.
revenueModel.evidence: We receive various types of fees from our franchise partners.
